description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it, Tiller Engine and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Selesnya Sanctuary
Holding priority, activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{W}.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.
